tagline: Global leader in secure and decarbonized digital transformation
hero_kpi_rationale: Record high bookings with +10% order entry YoY demonstrates strong commercial momentum and client demand for Atos digital transformation services

kpis.name: Order Entry
kpis.explanation: Indicator of demand for Atos services and commercial growth
kpis.description: Order entry reflects strong commercial momentum and increasing client confidence in Atos digital transformation services

kpis.name: Digital Revenue
kpis.explanation: Share of revenue from digital, cloud, security and decarbonization solutions
kpis.description: Revenue share from digital, cloud, security and decarbonization activities reached 46% in 2020, up 6 points from 40% in 2019
kpis.signal: Digital revenue share increasing towards 65% mid-term target

kpis.name: Net Promoter Score
kpis.description: The Net Promoter Score measures customer satisfaction and willingness to recommend Atos. Score of 65 in 2020 vs 59 in 2019
kpis.signal: High customer satisfaction at 65 NPS, up from 59 in 2019

kpis.name: Great Place to Work Index
kpis.explanation: Workplace quality and employee satisfaction indicator
kpis.description: The Great Place to Work confidence index reflects employee satisfaction and workplace quality. Score of 65% in 2020 vs 58% in 2019
kpis.signal: Outstanding employee engagement score up from 58% in 2019

kpis.name: CO2 Emissions Reduction
kpis.explanation: Reduction in carbon emissions reflecting commitment to carbon neutrality by 2028
kpis.description: 15% reduction in CO2 emissions in 2020. Atos aims for net-zero carbon by 2028, 22 years ahead of the Paris Agreement
kpis.signal: 15% reduction in CO2 emissions, on track to net-zero by 2028

kpis.name: AI Adoption
kpis.explanation: Indicator of AI solution adoption within Atos portfolio
kpis.description: Measures integration of artificial intelligence solutions into Atos service offerings

ai_positioning.summary: Atos positions AI as part of future technology trends through its Journey 2024 report, without an explicit AI strategy in the 2020 report
evidence: Journey 2024 report mentions future technology trends
Mention of Atos Scaler accelerator for innovative startups
No quantified AI strategy or AI adoption explicitly detailed in the 2020 annual report
